あらすじ

One day, Yuma, who belongs to the Japanese archery club, receives a call from his uncle, the chief of his hometown village. “We’ve just built a sports training facility. Do you wanna stay there before it officially opens?” “Yes, let’s have a camp for training there.” Like this, Yuma and other members visit the town.
